$comment: Explosives (docs/EXPLOSIVES.md; owner, 2026-11-06: "dynamite block that explodes after a short time when placed, it causes blocks in a radius to be affected by physics and appropriate force applied"). Each entry is a placed block (`block`, placed unlit) and the block it becomes while its fuse burns (`lit`). `ignitedBy`: the held items' blocks (shared/blocks) whose Place aimed at the unlit block lights it instead of placing (a torch held against it). fuseSeconds: the fuse once lit. radiusM: every block within it (its cell centre) becomes a flung natural piece, but liquids and `indestructible` blocks; impulse (N·s): what a block at the centre is given, along the line from the blast (lifted by `lift`, a share of the face's up added before normalising), times the falloff share (1 − d / radiusM)^falloff, so its speed is that over its mass (½ m³ × density) and a heavy block at the edge barely moves; maxSpeedMs caps it. Players and bodies within reachM: a speed change of knockbackMs and damage points (health 100), times (1 − d / reachM)^falloff (standing on it kills). Bodies get impulse × that share. waterRadiusM: liquid cells within it are blown out (cleared; the water host refills the crater from round it). chainDelaySeconds: an unlit explosive caught in a blast is lit with a fuse drawn from this range, and a lit one's fuse is cut to it if longer. The effects are the clients' (Settings → Explosions): flash (a short point light and a fireball billboard), smoke and dust (billboard puffs; cpuCount on a CPU adapter), the boom (the event `explode` of the block's sound set: full within fullM, gone at hearM), a camera shake within radiusM. `limits`: the most blasts the server sets off a tick (more wait a tick) and the most pieces one blast flings (the farthest cells beyond go as they are). Prototype content (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1). Run `node shared/explosives/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-world/src/explosives.gen.rs is stale.
